{{Quote|Where do I know the name Selaggis from?''"<br />"''Another Zsinj strike zone. One of the first I looked at after I assumed command of this task force. One of the moons of Selaggis Six was colonized. I guess Zsinj decided to make a lesson of someone colonizing on his border without his permission. ''Iron Fist'' wiped out the whole colony. I think it would be very appropriate if he were wiped out in the same system.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="SC" />}}
'''Selcaron''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Selaggis VI]] located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
{{Quote|They're descending toward the west coast of the primary continent. I think that's where the colony used to be. Atmospheric conditions not helpful. Heavy rain, heavy winds.|[[Kell Tainer]], to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SC" />}}
Selcaron was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located within the [[Selaggis system/Legends|Selaggis system]]<ref name="SC" /> of the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]], which connected it to the [[Bandomeer system/Legends|Bandomeer]] and [[Vahaba system/Legends|Vahaba systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Selcaron was one of the moons of [[Selaggis VI]], a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Selaggis]]. Its surface featured [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] and brown soil.<ref name="SC" /> The moon had a favorable climate that attracted [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]].<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Most of the Rogues and Wraiths received a communication from an unknown craft as we were departing Selcaron.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SC" />}}
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Selcaron was the location of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Unidentified colony (Selcaron)|colony]] that was [[Attack on Selcaron|attacked]] by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]],<ref name="DoaE1" /> who used his [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], the [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], to obliterate the colony.<ref name="SC" />

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You saw what the ''Iron Fist'' did on Selaggis. It turned the whole colony into rubble.|Han Solo|<ref name="TCoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>}}
Selcaron was introduced in the [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', written by [[Dave Wolverton]], which mentioned Selaggis as the location of a colony that was obliterated by Warlord Zsinj's Super Star Destroyer ''Iron Fist''.<ref name="TCoPL" />

Selaggis then appeared in the [[1998]] PC [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], which described it as a planet with a "favorable climate that has attracted colonists."<ref name="SWR" />

The [[1999]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]], later identified the planet as the gas giant Selaggis Six, and [[Retroactive continuity|changed]] the location of the colony to one of its moons, Selcaron.<ref name="SC" />
